secrets_cmd_description: Your API keys, kept outside every project (the user key store): secrets list, secrets set <NAME>, secrets unset <NAME>, secrets test <NAME>. No value is ever shown.
secrets_unknown_action_fix: Use: jgates secrets list, jgates secrets set <NAME>, jgates secrets unset <NAME> or jgates secrets test <NAME>.
secrets_unexpected_argument_fix: jgates secrets list takes no argument; set, unset and test take only the name.
secrets_missing_name: jgates secrets {action} needs the name of the variable (for example OPENROUTER_API_KEY).
secrets_invalid_name: Invalid name: a name has capital letters, digits and "_", and does not start with a digit.
secrets_invalid_name_fix: Use the name of the environment variable, for example OPENROUTER_API_KEY or MY_GATEWAY_KEY.
secrets_value_as_argument: The value of {name} is never taken as an argument (it would stay in the shell history and in the process list). Nothing was stored.
secrets_value_as_argument_fix: Run jgates secrets set {name} and type the value (it is not shown), or pipe it in: printf %s "$VALUE" | jgates secrets set {name}.
secrets_prompt: Value of {name} (not shown, Enter to save, Ctrl+C to cancel):
secrets_cancelled_fix: Run the command again to store the value.
secrets_set_done: {name} stored in {path} (outside the project). The value is not shown again.
secrets_env_wins: The environment variable {name} is set and wins over the stored value while it stays set.
secrets_unset_absent: {name} is not in {path}: nothing to remove.
secrets_unset_env_still: The environment variable {name} is still set: the provider keeps using it.
secrets_list_header: User key store: {path} (outside every project; the environment variable wins over the store)
secrets_fix_invalid_name: Use the name of the environment variable, for example OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
secrets_fix_invalid_value: Give a value with no line break; an empty value is not stored (use jgates secrets unset to remove a name).
secrets_fix_vault_unreadable: Check the file named above: fix or remove it (the stored keys are lost if you remove it).
secrets_fix_vault_blocked: This command runs only with the environment; set the variable in the environment.
secrets_fix_vault_write_failed: Check the permissions of the folder named above.
secrets_not_testable: {name} is not the key of a known provider: there is nothing to test it against.
secrets_not_testable_fix: jgates secrets test works with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENCODE_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY and SEMANTIC_GATE_API_KEY.
secrets_not_set: {name} is set neither in the environment nor in the key store.
secrets_not_set_fix: Store it first: jgates secrets set {name}.
secrets_needs_base_url: {name} belongs to the openai-compatible provider, which needs the address of the gateway to be tested.
secrets_needs_base_url_fix: Set SEMANTIC_GATE_BASE_URL to the gateway address (for example http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1) and run jgates secrets test {name} again.
secrets_test_ok: {name} works with {provider} (from the {source}): {count} model(s) listed, no token spent.
secrets_test_failed_fix: Check the key (jgates secrets set {name} replaces it) and the network; the test only lists the models, it sends no prompt.
